description: Document an EXISTING network: read its nodes and connections and return a readable map — counts by operator family and type, plus a Mermaid flowchart of the data flow you can paste into docs. Unlike plan_visual (which plans from a description), this describes what's actually in the project. Use it to explain or hand off a patch.

recursive.description: Include all descendants (otherwise just the direct children).

name: document_network
title: Document network
